grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and verify you're under State Pension age before processing your ESA claim

grants.description: Access your National Insurance contribution record from HMRC
grants.purpose: To verify you've paid enough National Insurance contributions in the last 2-3 years to qualify for New Style ESA

grants.description: Share your fit note and medical information with DWP
grants.purpose: To assess how your health condition affects your ability to work and determine your eligibility for ESA

grants.description: Participate in a Work Capability Assessment and share the results with DWP
grants.purpose: To determine if your illness or disability affects how much you can work and which ESA group you should be placed in

grants.description: Share details of any current employment or income
grants.purpose: To determine if you're eligible while working and calculate the correct payment amount

grants.description: Check if you're claiming other benefits like Universal Credit or JSA
grants.purpose: To ensure you're not claiming benefits that prevent ESA eligibility and to coordinate payments correctly

grants.description: Share details of any private pension income
grants.purpose: To calculate your ESA payment correctly (pension income over £85/week affects your ESA amount)

grants.description: Provide your bank or building society details for payment
grants.purpose: To pay your ESA every 2 weeks

grants.description: Allow DWP to monitor your claim and request updated fit notes or evidence
grants.purpose: To ensure you continue to receive the correct amount of ESA and remain eligible

revocation.mechanism: Contact Jobcentre Plus on 0800 169 0310 or write to your local Jobcentre Plus office. You can also report changes through your GOV.UK account.
revocation.effect: Your ESA claim will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. You may be asked to repay any ESA already paid if eligibility changes.

delegation.limitations: Agent CANNOT: (1) Attend your Work Capability Assessment appointment on your behalf - you must participate personally; (2) Agree to your Claimant Commitment without your explicit verbal or written confirmation; (3) Decide whether to accept work-related activities - you must make this decision; (4) Provide medical evidence it doesn't have access to; (5) Apply for mandatory reconsideration or appeal without your explicit instruction; (6) Agree to sanctions or hardship payment terms without your knowledge; (7) Authorize appointee access for someone else; (8) Make decisions about whether you should apply for end-of-life special rules - this is your choice with medical professional support.
